description: Write a letter to the people you love, to be read later — the things you'd want them to know, the stories only you hold, the permission and the love that outlive you. Use when someone says 'help me write a letter to my kids/partner', 'legacy letter', 'ethical will', 'something for them to have when I'm gone', or is facing illness, aging, deployment, or simply wants to. An emotional-legacy tool, not legal (it is not a will).
